summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. furnished a 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement on share purchases tied to its long-term incentive plans. The company disclosed acquiring 5,095,943 ordinary shares since August 18, 2026, with daily purchases from September 3-8 at average prices of €16.45-€16.96, totaling about €19.67 million. These open-market buys, executed across Euronext, CBOE, DXE and Turquoise Europe, are routine treasury share purchases to satisfy LTIP obligations, not a special-situation event; the originally planned forward contracts covered up to 5.5 million shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock is relevant. Watch for completion versus the 5.5 million share cap and any disclosure if the program is expanded beyond incentive-plan needs.
